# Parameters: visualization-renderer

The command line of `primeatlas/visualization/shared/renderer.py` (Rings, Tree, Sphere and Assembly sub-tabs launch it; each mode adds its own arguments through `VizMode.add_arguments`). The sub-tabs persist their last values in `app_settings.json` (data.md). "What it does" is the argparse help text.

| Parameter | Default | Type and bounds | Owner | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--audio` | off | flag | `renderer_cli.py` | enable optional live sound (requires sounddevice) |
| `--sound-low` | `sine` | one of sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, bell, choir, mute | `renderer_cli.py` | (no help text) |
| `--sound-prime` | `triangle` | one of sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, bell, choir, mute | `renderer_cli.py` | (no help text) |
| `--sound-lcm` | `choir` | one of sine, triangle, square, sawtooth, bell, choir, mute | `renderer_cli.py` | (no help text) |
| `--source` | `synthetic` | one of synthetic, sieve, archive, none | `renderer_cli.py` | (no help text) |
| `--count` | `1000000` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | ring count for --source synthetic |
| `--upto` | `1000000` | big integer (digits, a*10**b, a*10^b, aEb) | `renderer_cli.py` | upper bound for --source sieve/archive -- accepts plain digits, a*10**b, a*10^b, or scientific notation (aEb) |
| `--portal-folder` | none | text | `renderer_cli.py` | PrimeAtlas portal folder for --source archive |
| `--width` | `1600` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | (no help text) |
| `--height` | `1000` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | (no help text) |
| `--point-size` | `3.0` | number | `renderer_cli.py` | (no help text) |
| `--hit-point-size` | `40.0` | number | `renderer_cli.py` | point size for rings on the vertical reference line (divisors of N); defaults to 40.0 |
| `--hud-font-size` | `35` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | pixel size of the on-canvas HUD text, default 35 |
| `--n-step` | `1000` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | (no help text) |
| `--load-range` | `` | text | `renderer_cli.py` | comma-separated FROM,TO (each accepts plain digits, a*10**b, a*10^b, or aEb -- see --upto) -- switch to a fixed range mode showing exactly the primes in [FROM,TO], auto-tracking all of them if there aren't too many |
| `--max-load-count` | `2000000` | big integer (digits, a*10**b, a*10^b, aEb) | `renderer_cli.py` | safety cap on primes materialized for an archive --load-range load; the range is truncated from the top if it holds more than this (accepts plain digits, a*10**b, a*10^b, or aEb -- see --upto) |
| `--slide-load-range` | off | flag | `renderer_cli.py` | --load-range only: instead of a fixed slice stuck wherever --max-load-count first landed, keep a bounded chunk that SLIDES (both directions) as N/the pattern cursor moves, so the whole --load-range span becomes reachable a chunk at a time. Off by default -- turn on deliberately, since the extra disk I/O on each chunk swap may not suit every machine |
| `--slide-chunk-size` | none | big integer (digits, a*10**b, a*10^b, aEb) | `renderer_cli.py` | --slide-load-range only: how many primes each of the back/current/forward chunks holds -- defaults to --max-load-count's own value when not given, so leaving this blank keeps ONE consistent load size; give a real value here to deliberately use a DIFFERENT size while sliding than the initial load (accepts plain digits, a*10**b, a*10^b, or aEb -- see --upto) |
| `--tempo-ms` | `120` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | playback speed in ms/tick, clamped to [30,2000] (Space starts/stops playback, ]/[ adjust it live) |
| `--viz-mode` | `rings` | one of rings, line, tree, assembly, sphere, sphere_fibers | `renderer_cli.py` | rings (default): one ring per active small prime, phase = n%%p. line: a fixed row of real primes from --load-range, with an optional --pattern-seed-k/--pattern-seed-start k-tuple pattern slid along it by N. tree: the prime tree on the real n axis (use with --source none). assembly: the wheel assembled level by level, q copies of the period minus the multiples of q (use with --source none). sphere: the first K primes as rings on a sphere through one node, N's divisors meet at it (use with --source none; --portal-folder gives primality and the prime jumps) |
| `--pipe-stdin-commands` | off | flag | `renderer_cli.py` | read RESUME commands from stdin and, instead of exiting on window-close, hide the window and idle until one arrives (used by rings_tab.py for live pause/resume; harmless but pointless when running this file directly from a terminal) |
| `--windows` | `` | text | `renderer_cli.py` | comma-separated window families to highlight: bertrand,legendre,generalLaw |
| `--general-law-theta` | `0.5` | number | `renderer_cli.py` | (no help text) |
| `--general-law-mode` | `sliding` | one of stepped, sliding, bertrand, legendre | `renderer_cli.py` | (no help text) |
| `--track-primes` | `` | text | `renderer_cli.py` | comma-separated prime values to track, e.g. 2,3,5 |
| `--auto-orbit` | off | flag | `renderer_cli.py` | auto-cycle through active primes instead of a fixed Track P list |
| `--pattern-seed-k` | none | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | line mode only: take this many real consecutive primes >= --pattern-seed-start as the sliding k-tuple pattern's offsets |
| `--pattern-seed-start` | none | big integer (digits, a*10**b, a*10^b, aEb) | `renderer_cli.py` | line mode only: starting prime (must be > 2) for --pattern-seed-k |
| `--pattern-step-mode` | `manual` | one of manual, auto | `renderer_cli.py` | line mode pattern only: 'manual' (default) always takes a single wheel step per navigation key; 'auto' always seeks instead (see --pattern-stop-on-match for which kind) |
| `--pattern-stop-on-match` | off | flag | `renderer_cli.py` | line mode pattern only, and only with --pattern-step-mode auto: seek the next real MATCH! when given, or specifically the next NON-match wheel candidate when not given |
| `--line-axis-curved` | off | flag | `renderer_cli.py` | line mode only: draw the axis bent into a circle instead of a straight line (purely visual -- the loaded window's own start/end coincide on screen, marked with a red boundary line, since they are NOT actually the same value the way a real periodic wraparound would be) |
| `--tree-depth` | `8` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: how many consecutive primes (levels) the tree holds |
| `--tree-branches` | `3` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: child copies drawn per copy of p; the rest of its p-1 branches are shown as '+N' |
| `--tree-height` | `1.5` | number | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode, real axis: window height as a multiple of the levels' span (start to the next prime after the last level, >= 1) |
| `--tree-max-nodes` | `100000` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: drawn-copy cap; levels past it are left out |
| `--tree-multiples` | `4` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode, multiples axis: multiples p..kp shown per level (>= 2) |
| `--tree-axis` | `auto` | one of auto, real, multiples | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: vertical axis -- real n, the multiples of the level primes, or auto (real while the multiples fit one window) |
| `--tree-max-points` | `500000` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: cap on column markers; the window shrinks to fit it |
| `--tree-max-labels` | `3000` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: cap on column-marker value labels |
| `--tree-max-stripes` | `4` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: color stripes per marker (1..6); past it the last stripe turns white |
| `--tree-node-size` | `15.0` | number | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: node marker size in pixels (column markers use --point-size) |
| `--tree-label-font-size` | `35` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: pixel size of the labels next to nodes and columns |
| `--tree-colors` | `` | text | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: per-prime color overrides, e.g. '2=#ff0000,3=#00aaff' |
| `--tree-bare` | off | flag | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: draw the bare diagram, without labels and HUD |
| `--tree-highlight` | `` | text | `renderer_cli.py` | tree mode: comma-separated highlight layers (primes) |
| `--assembly-depth` | `6` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: steps (primes 2, 3, 5, ...) the animation assembles |
| `--assembly-frames` | `12` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: ticks per phase (copy, strike, prime, collapse) |
| `--assembly-lane-dots` | `48` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: lanes drawn as dots on each copy at most; past it only counts |
| `--assembly-detail-cells` | `2310` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: grid cells (q x period) drawn at most; 0 = no grid |
| `--assembly-max-labels` | `3000` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: grid value labels at most |
| `--assembly-max-lanes` | `200000` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: lanes enumerated at most (per-copy removals); past it only the counts |
| `--assembly-node-size` | `15.0` | number | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: floor and copy marker size in pixels |
| `--assembly-cell-size` | `12.0` | number | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: grid cell and lane dot size in pixels |
| `--assembly-cell-spacing` | `auto` | text | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: grid cell spacing in pixels at the launch view, or 'auto' to fit the grid and shrink cells to their spacing |
| `--assembly-label-font-size` | `35` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: pixel size of the labels |
| `--assembly-colors` | `` | text | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: per-prime color overrides, e.g. '2=#ff0000,3=#00aaff' |
| `--assembly-bare` | off | flag | `renderer_cli.py` | assembly mode: draw without labels and HUD |
| `--sphere-rings` | `200` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | sphere mode: rings = the first K primes (1..1,000,000) |
| `--sphere-frames` | `8` | integer | `renderer_cli.py` | sphere mode: playback ticks per N (the points glide between N and N+1) |
